name: Vireo
fantasy: The storm-kite runner. Points and crackles bolts from her fingertip until a foe is fully charged, then runs straight through them as a streak of lightning and comes out with the dash back.
silhouette: the copper rod mast and kite pennant on the back

card.loop: Ranged lightning skirmisher: charge one foe to 4 Static, then Wirerun through them.
card.dash: Wirerun: hold to charge a lane (length grows with the hold), let go to streak; through a 4-Static foe it hits double and comes back at once.
card.passive: Static: every hit adds a stack (4 max, shown over their head). The 4th calls a sky bolt and makes them Live.
card.rmb: Storm Rod: hold to summon a copper rod, let go to throw it to full range. It knocks the first foe back, stuns them on a wall and leaves a charge orb.
card.e: Skycall: drop a circle at your cursor, then flick the mouse to pick the drag. 0.8s later lightning drags everyone inside that way and grounds them.

weapons.coilcaster: Finger bolts every 0.8s, left hand then right, out to full range through everyone in line. Each hit adds 1 Static.

passive.name: Static
passive.desc: Your finger bolts, Storm Rod and Skycall each add Static to what they hit (Skycall adds 2; up to 4, 4.5s, refreshed by every hit). A marker over their head shows the count, with sparks on them that grow with every stack. The 4th stack calls a sky bolt onto them: they are Live. Wirerun through a Live foe for a Blowout: the run hits double, plus 16 damage and 18% of their health, their Static is spent and Wirerun is back at once. Nothing else gives Wirerun back. Knocking a hunter down heals you for 15% of your health.

dash.name: Wirerun
dash.desc: Press and hold: the run is charged at once (its cooldown starts on the press). A lane grows 5 to 8.5m over 0.6s, its end marked by a big ring; you can't steer yourself while you hold it, you keep your height, and any speed you had keeps drifting you. Let go and you streak along it as lightning at a steady 32m/s (shots pass through you), carrying that drift. Every foe you cross takes 10. A foe at 4 Static takes double, a Blowout, and Wirerun is back at once: the only way it comes back early.

variants.tap: Let go early (it still takes 0.3s to summon): 18 damage and a short knock, flying the full 13m lane.
variants.hold: Hold to 1s (your body flashes when it's full; at 1.2s it throws itself): 30 damage and about 1.8m of knockback. Thrown into a wall or another foe they're stunned 0.8s. Every foe hit leaves a charge orb at the impact that zaps nearby foes with Static; Wirerun through the orb bursts it for 2 Static on everyone near it.

e.name: Skycall
e.desc: Press to drop a circle at your cursor (up to 11m), then flick the mouse within 0.3s to set the drag: toward you pulls them in, away throws them out (no flick: away from you). A pillar of light narrows over it for 0.8s, then lightning strikes: 20 damage, 2 Static, and everyone inside is dragged along the ground about 7m that way and Grounded for 1.5s (no dashing). Charge orbs it catches are flung the same way and become yours.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 8s -> 6.4s, damage +30%; +20% damage on top.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 8s -> 6.4s; the run's own hit deals +50%.

tells.half: a marker over every foe with Static: one pip per stack and the count, sparks on them that grow
tells.full: a Live foe: a sky bolt lands on them, four bright pips spin fast and gold sparks crackle
tells.dash_spent: a fading lightning streak where the run went
